# Temporal Validation Quality Checklist: Prevent Past-Time Temporal Requests

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality review checklist validating the completeness, clarity, consistency, and edge-case coverage of temporal constraints across availability, reservation, and waiting list domains.
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness across Services

- [x] CHK001 - Are temporal validation requirements defined for all three targeted services (`availability-service`, `reservation-service`, `waiting-list-service`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 - Are requirements explicitly bounded so read-only historical endpoints (such as viewing past reservation logs) are not mistakenly blocked by future-time rules? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 - Does the specification document an explicit maximum advance booking horizon (365 days) across all booking and queueing services? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements specified for handling missing or null date-time parameters in each incoming query or payload? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements]
- [x] CHK005 - Are the required date and time string formats (ISO-8601 UTC timestamp vs. local date and time) explicitly stated for each service contract? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK006 - Does the spec define what happens when an invalid restaurant ID is passed alongside a temporal validation request? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Temporal Boundary & Clock-Skew Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is the clock-skew grace period quantified with an exact duration threshold (5 minutes / 300 seconds)? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the direction of the clock-skew grace window unambiguously defined as a subtraction from the current timestamp (`now - 5m`) rather than an addition? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the grace period requirement consistently applied across both availability inquiries and reservation creation requests? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK010 - Does the specification define whether the 5-minute grace period applies to the maximum advance boundary (365 days) or strictly to the lower past-time boundary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK011 - Are boundary behaviors documented for requests submitted at exactly the threshold timestamp (`requested == now - 300s`)? [Edge Case, Clarity]
- [x] CHK012 - Is clock source abstraction or injectable clocking defined to support deterministic boundary evaluation in automated test suites? [Testability, Spec §SC-004]

## Timezone Resolution & Operational Consistency

- [x] CHK013 - Does the specification define how the reference timezone is determined when evaluating local date and time coordinates? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK014 - Is a concrete fallback timezone (`Europe/Amsterdam`) specified when restaurant timezone metadata is unavailable or unresolvable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK015 - Does the specification differentiate between absolute UTC timestamps (`Instant`) and local wall-clock coordinates (`LocalDate` + `LocalTime`)? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK016 - Are requirements defined for cross-day boundary transitions occurring near midnight roll-over in the restaurant's operational timezone? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 - Does the spec clarify whether daylight saving time (DST) shifts in the restaurant's IANA timezone affect same-day operational calculations? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Same-Day Window & Clamping Logic Coverage

- [x] CHK018 - Are requirements defined for evaluating combined `(date, time)` coordinates when the date is today but the time is in the past? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK019 - For waiting list entries on the current date, does the specification unambiguously require both `earliestTime` and `latestTime` to be in the future? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK020 - Is the automatic clamping rule clearly defined when a same-day waiting list request has an `earliestTime` within the 5-minute grace window? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK021 - Does the spec define the rejection behavior when a same-day waiting list request has an `earliestTime` within the grace window but a `latestTime` earlier than current time? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK022 - Are ordering constraints between `earliestTime` and `latestTime` (`earliestTime <= latestTime`) consistently required across all dates? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3]

## API Contract & Error Payload Specification

- [x] CHK023 - Are rejection responses explicitly specified to use HTTP 400 Bad Request across all three microservices? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK024 - Does the specification require error response payloads to conform to the RFC 7807 Problem Details schema? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK025 - Are field-level error mapping rules (`invalidParams` array with `name` and `reason`) defined for temporal validation failures? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK026 - Are specific error messages defined for each parameter rejection (`date`, `time`, `startTime`, `targetDate`, `earliestTime`, `latestTime`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK027 - Is `AvailabilityController` exception translation specified so temporal validation failures return HTTP 400 rather than being swallowed as HTTP 404? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]

## Policy & Role-Based Back-Filling Governance

- [x] CHK028 - Is past-time rejection strictly enforced for all customers and unauthenticated callers while explicitly permitting `ROLE_RESTAURANT_MANAGER` and `ROLE_ADMIN` back-filling? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK029 - Does the spec define back-filling permissions exclusively for availability checks and reservation creation, while keeping waiting list joins strictly future-only across all roles? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK030 - Are unauthenticated requests subjected to strict past-time validation prior to reaching downstream business logic? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK031 - Does the specification clearly bound customer booking capabilities so past reservations cannot be created by non-staff through any API route? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]

## Measurability & Testability Criteria

- [x] CHK032 - Can the 100% rejection rate for past temporal requests be objectively measured and verified in automated tests? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK033 - Can the zero false-positive rejection criterion for valid present and future requests be verified through automated regression suites? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK034 - Are measurable outcomes technology-agnostic and free from implementation-specific code assertions? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK035 - Are acceptance scenarios structured in testable Given-When-Then format covering both negative past-time and positive future-time paths? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
